title: npm Plugin Market
subtitle: Browse the plugin versions published from the private npm registry. Publishing, withdrawing and restoring a version are platform admin actions, available in the admin console.
search: Search by plugin, package name or version
empty: No plugin in the market yet
emptyHint: Publish a version from the private npm registry and it will show up here.
emptySearchHint: Try another keyword or switch the scope.

loadState.title: Failed to load the plugin market
loadState.hint: The list could not be fetched — the network may be down or the service temporarily unavailable. Retrying usually helps; contact an administrator if it keeps failing.
loadState.detailHint: This entry's version history could not be fetched. Retrying usually helps; pick another entry or try again later if it keeps failing.
loadState.unauthorizedTitle: No access to the plugin market
loadState.unauthorizedHint: This account or organization no longer has access to the plugin market. Switch organization or ask an administrator for access — retrying will not change the authorization result.

detail.noAgents: This version declares no agent member
detail.noServers: This version declares no MCP server
detail.deprecated: This version is marked as deprecated
detail.hiddenPackage: This plugin is fully withdrawn: it is invisible on the public face and reappears once any version is restored.
detail.noVersions: This entry has no version yet

dialog.publishDescription: Enter the package name and exact version on the private registry. The metadata is read and normalized first; once confirmed the snapshot enters the market and no longer follows the registry.
dialog.previewHint: Only the fields below are stored. The artifact URL is kept for provenance and is never requested by the market.
dialog.previewChanged: The version changed after the preview. Below is the snapshot just read; please confirm again.
dialog.previewFailed: Failed to read the preview. Check the package name and exact version, then retry.
dialog.unpublishDescription: {{version}} stops being public, but its snapshot stays in the market and can be restored at any time.
dialog.restoreDescription: {{version}} becomes public again from the frozen snapshot in the market; the registry is not read again.

toast.loadListFailed: Failed to load the plugin market

admin.title: Plugin market admin
admin.subtitle: Publish, withdraw or restore the plugin versions of the private npm registry (master key protected).
admin.gateDescription: Enter the system master key (RCS_SYSTEM_API_KEYS) to open the admin panel. The key is kept only in sessionStorage and is never logged.
